Waxaad ku jirtaa kooxda tafatirka wargeyska Ingiriisiga dugsiga. Laba ogeysiis oo ku saabsan xafladda ayaa isaga kala duwan.

Ogeysiiska dugsiga: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Boostada golaha ardayda: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

x-e-h1-01.title: Ma hal xaalad ayaa caddayn kartaa in la yiraahdo 'had iyo jeer'?
x-e-h1-01.goal: Qoraal murankiis ah, hel sadarka caddayntu aysan ku filnayn in ay taageerto sheegashada, ku dib u qor weedh taxaddar badan, oo go'aami caddayn intee leeg ayaa dheeraad ah loo baahan yahay.
x-e-h1-01.material:
Kani waa qayb ka mid ah qoraal lagu daabacay joornaalka dugsiga (lambarrada sadarrada waxay ka bilaabmaan 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
x-e-h1-01.thinking.0: Helidda farqiga u dhexeeya caddaynta iyo gabagabada
x-e-h1-01.thinking.2: Dib u qorista sheegasho si ay ugu habboonaato caddaynta
x-e-h1-01.prereq.0: Akhrinta qoraal gaaban oo muran ah oo Ingiriisi ah heerka sannadka koowaad ee dugsiga sare
x-e-h1-01.prereq.1: Dareen maalinle ah in 'sabab' iyo 'ku dhaca isla waqti si kadis ah' ay kala duwanaan karaan
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Qoraalkan, kee ayaa ah sadarka ugu horreeya ee gabagabo ka weyn caddaynta sadarka 2 ka dhigaya?
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta, kala saar 'waxa uu sheegay' iyo 'waxa uu gabagabeeyay'.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sadar kasta dhinaciisa ku qor in sadarku ka hadlayo hal qof, dad qaar, mise qof walba, oo la barbar dhig caddaynta sadarrada hore.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 waa dhibaatada. In la yiraahdo darajooyinku "hubaal" ay xumaan doonaan "ardayda oo dhan" iyadoo lagu salaynayo hoos u dhac dhibic hal arday oo keliya (sadarka 2) waa gabagabo ka weyn caddaynta. Hoos u dhac dhibic wuxuu sidoo kale yeelan karaa sababo kale, sida adkaanta imtixaanka ama xaaladda jirka. Sadarka 4 wuxuu bixiyay sabab nooc kale ah oo ka duwan darajooyinka (buuq, khiyaano), sidaa darteed si gooni ah ayaa loo tixgelinayaa. "Banned for everyone" ee sadarka 5 sidoo kale wuxuu ku salaysan yahay gabagabadan, laakiin meesha ugu horreysa ee dhibaatadu ka bilaabato waa sadarka 3.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Xog cusub oo kee ah ayaa si ugu wanaagsan u tijaabin karta in sheegashada sadarka 3 sax tahay?
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir haddii, marka aad ururiso xogta xulasho kasta, isla xogtaas ay soo bixi karto xitaa haddii sadarka 3 khalad yahay.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii yeelashada dhowr xaaladood oo dheeraad ah oo isku nooc ah ay meesha ka saaraan sababaha kale.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.a: Aragtida dadku way ka duwanaan kartaa isbeddelka dhabta ah ee darajooyinka.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.c: Tani waxay ururisaa xaalado badan oo isku nooc ah. Ma meesha ka saarto sababaha kale ee dhibcaha ardaydaas hoos ugu dhaceen.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.d: Sida taleefannada loogu isticmaalo fasalka si toos ah uma muujiyo xidhiidhka darajooyinka.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.explain: Haddii aad isbarbar dhigto ardayda leh taleefan iyo ardayda aan lahayn isla muddo, waxaad miisaami kartaa haddii sharraxaadda 'taleefannada dartood' ay ka fiicantahay sababaha kale. Ururinta xaalado dheeraad ah ama weydiinta aragtida waxay keliya ka dhigaysaa sheegashada mid xoog badan oo la dareemo.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka 3 si uu ugu habboonaado caddaynta sadarka 2 (1-2 weedhood oo Ingiriisi ah), oo sidoo kale qor xog dheeraad ah oo loo baahan yahay si loo hubiyo sheegashada.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore soo koob xaaladda Mina.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.hint.1: Isku day inaad ku darto labadaba 'ma caddeeyo' iyo 'xogta loo baahan yahay'.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma weedhda aad qortay waxay sheegaysaa wax ka badan macluumaadka sadarka 2 (hal arday)?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Xogta aad magacowday, ma la barbar dhigi kartaa 'xaaladda aan taleefan lahayn'?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma weedhdu waxay muujinaysaa in laga yaabo inay jiraan sababo kale?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Waxay si toos ah u sheegtay sababaha kale.

x-e-h1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii aad dareentay is-khilaaf tilmaanta labaad, waxaad u akhriyi kartaa in Mina ay yar cabsatay laakiin ay aqbashay Tom oo ay daysay niyadda.
x-e-h1-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Way ka cabsatay inuu daahay, laakiin way soo dhaweysay Tom oo waxay rabtaa inay la joogto.
x-e-h1-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Weli way cadhaysan tahay oo waxay rabtaa in Tom tago.
x-e-h1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ma jaan qaadayso 'Come on' iyo 'bixinta kursi'.
x-e-h1-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Bilowgii ma aysan aad u dan gelin, 'Great.' sidoo kale waa mid daacad ah.
x-e-h1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waa suurtagal, laakiin ma sharxi karto in is-khilaaf uu ka dhashay tilmaanta labaad.
x-e-h1-04.s.s1.reflect: Ma tafsiirkaagu is beddelay mar kasta oo tilmaamuhu kordheen? Haddii uu is beddelay, magacow hal weedh oo keentay.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.prompt: Waa maxay sababta ugu muhiimsan ee 'Great.' ka dhigaysa mid loo akhriyo cabsi halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa macne wanaagsan?
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi haddii sabab kasta runtii ay ku qoran tahay sheekaysiga.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mar kale akhri 'Great.' adigoo u malaynaya in xaaladda 40 daqiiqo daahitaanka aysan jirin.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.a: Sababtoo ah erayadu waa kuwo wanaagsan, laakiin ma jaan qaadaan xaaladda ah inuu daahay.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.b: Sababtoo ah "Great" inta badan waa eray sarcasm ah oo Ingiriisi ah.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.r.b: Kani waa guud-ka-dhigis ah in hal eray had iyo jeer uu leeyahay isla macnaha.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.c: Sababtoo ah codka Mina wuu sarreeyay.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.r.c: Sheekaysigan macluumaad ku saabsan codkeeda ma laha. Waa sabab la sameeyay oo aan ka mid ahayn tilmaamaha la bixiyay.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.explain: Macnaha lama go'aamiyo erayada oo keliya laakiin iyadoo la eego in erayadu ku habboon yihiin xaaladda. Marka erayadu wanaagsan yihiin laakiin xaaladdu xun tahay, waxaad shaki ku qaadan kartaa macne qarsoon.

x-e-h1-05.title: Ma 'I have a test' waa diidmo mise maya?
x-e-h1-05.goal: Kala saar macluumaad dheeraad ah oo loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo macnaha jawaabtu aanay si toos ah u sheegin (haddii ay tahay diidmo), oo qor fariin wax weydiisa aan fahan-xumo keenin.
x-e-h1-05.material:
Kuwani waa fariimo qoraal ah oo u dhexeeya Jin iyo Hana.

Jin: Are you coming to the study group tonight?
Hana: I have a huge test tomorrow.
Jin: So is that a no?
Hana: Haha, I don't know yet.
x-e-h1-05.thinking.0: Aragtida in macnaha qarsoon aanu ahayn mid go'an oo keliya
x-e-h1-05.thinking.1: Kala saarista macluumaadka loo baahan yahay xukunka iyo macluumaadka aan loo baahnayn
x-e-h1-05.prereq.0: Akhrinta farriimo qoraal Ingiriis ah oo gaaban heerka sannadka koowaad ee dugsiga sare
x-e-h1-05.prereq.1: Khibradda maalinlaha ah ee ah jawaab laga yaabo inaysan si toos ah uga jawaabin su'aasha
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay inaad wax badan ka ogaato si aad u go'aamiso haddii Hana imaanayso.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sawir hal kiis oo jawaabta Hana macnaheedu yahay 'ma tegi karo' iyo hal kiis oo macnaheedu yahay 'waan tegi doonaa'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Doorashooyinka ku raadi macluumaadka kala saaraya labada kiis.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.b: Waqtiga imtixaanka si toos ah ugama xidhna in Hana timaaddo.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.d: Tirada dadka si toos ah looguma isticmaalo go'aaminta doorashada Hana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.explain: Erayada Hana waxay noqon karaan macnaha 'ma tegi karo sababtoo ah imtixaanka', ama 'waan tegi doonaa si aan imtixaanka u wada barano'. Sidaas darteed waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato haddii kooxdu tahay isla imtixaanka, iyo qof noocee ah ayay Hana tahay marka ay wax baranayso.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Ujeedada kooxdu waa macluumaadka ugu muhiimsan ee xukunka. Waxay ka sii fiicantahay inaad sidoo kale eegto caadooyinka waxbarasho ee Hana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.1: Caadooyinka waxbarashadu waa muhiim, laakiin sidoo kale waa inaad eegtaa haddii kooxdu tahay isla imtixaanka.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.prompt: Sida Jin, qor farriin Ingiriis ah oo loo diro Hana (1-3 weedh). Shuruudaha: sheeg imtixaanka/waxbarashada, ku dar ugu yaraan hal su'aal ay ku jawaabi karto cadaadis la'aan, oo soo jeedi talaabo ama doorashooyin lagu wada barto.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir laba jid oo Hana dooran karto (timaado oo wax baro, guriga wax ku baro).
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isku day qaabka 'Do you want to ...?' ama 'If you ..., we could ...'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Farriintu ma siinaysaa Hana meel ay ku doorato iyadoo aan la riixin?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma waydiisay si xaaladdu ugu beddelmi karto iyadoo ku xiran jawaabta Hana?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma runtii waydiisay ama u sheegtay macluumaadka aad ku doortay tallaabada 1?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxay weydiisay haddii ay tahay isla imtixaanka oo ku dartay shuruud.

x-e-h1-07.title: Waddada baaskiilka cusub runtii ma yareysay shilalka?
x-e-h1-07.goal: Marka caddayn lagu daro hal-hal, dib u qiimee sida sheegashadu u qanciso, oo sabab leh sharax lambarkee ayaa dhibaatada xalliya.
x-e-h1-07.material: Tani waa sheegasho ka timid maqaal magaalo. "The new bike lane made our street safer." Akhri tilmaamaha kala horreyn ahaan.
x-e-h1-07.prereq.0: Akhrinta maqaal Ingiriis ah oo gaaban heerka sannadka koowaad ee dugsiga sare
x-e-h1-07.prereq.1: Faham maalinle ah oo ku filan in lagu kala saaro 'heerka' iyo 'tirada'
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Mar kasta oo aad akhrido tilmaan, ka xukun sida sheegashadu u taageeran tahay.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi haddii tilmaanta cusub ay bixinayso sabab kale oo sharxi karta lambarkii hore.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kala sooc haddii lambarku yahay 'imisa kiis' mise 'imisa kiis imisa qof ah'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tilmaantan oo keliya, sheegashadu sidee bay u taageeran tahay?
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Ka yar sida isla bilkii hore sannadkii hore waxay tilmaamaysaa isla jihada sheegashada, laakiin waa hal bil oo keliya.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Tilmaamo aad u yar ayaa jira si lagu go'aamiyo lambarka hal bil.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxaa lagu taageeray heer ahaan, laakiin waa hal bil oo keliya, sidaas darteed waxaan u baahanahay inaan sii eegno.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Shilal yar waa macluumaad la xidhiidha sheegashada.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Eeg tilmaantan cusub oo beddel xukunkaaga ku saabsan sheegashada.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Ma ogaan kartid haddii shilalku hoos u dhaceen sababtoo ah waddada mise sababtoo ah dad yar ayaa fuulay marka roob uu da'ay.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sheegashadu way daciifowday. Shilalku laga yaabo inay hoos u dhaceen sababtoo ah dad yar ayaa fuulay baaskiillada.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Haddii dad yar ay fuulaan, shilalku sidoo kale way hoos u dhici karaan.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Hadda waa hubaal in sheegashadu been tahay.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxay daciifowday oo keliya; ma aha caddayn inay been tahay.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Akhri ilaa tilmaanta ugu dambaysa oo soo koob xukunkaaga.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Muddadu way dheeraatay, inkasta oo tirada fuulayaashu kordhay, heerka shilalka wuu hoos u dhacay, sidaas darteed daciifnimadii ugu horreysay waa la xaliyay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma odhan kartid sabab kale ma jirto gabi ahaanba.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sheegashada aad bay uga wanaagsan tahay taageero.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Weli caddayn gabi ahaanba ma jirto.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Barbar dhig tixgelinaya muddada hal sano iyo tirada fuulayaasha ayaa lagu daray.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Waxaa la caddeeyay in waddadu tahay sababta kaliya.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Xogtan kuuma sheegi karto in sababtu tahay 'tan keliya'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Tilmaanteed ayay rumaysadkaagu aad u beddelmay? Hal weedh ku sheeg sababta.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Maxay tahay sababta 'shilal 1,000 fuulaye kasta' ee tallaabada 3 ay uga fiicantahay xallinta dhibaatada tallaabada 2?
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Xusuuso waxa ku saabsan tirada shilalka ee ahaa dhibaato tallaabada 2.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.a: Sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigtaa tirada shilalka inay u muuqato mid weyn, sidaas darteed way muuqataa
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.a: Lambar u muuqda mid weyn iyo barbar dhig cadaalad ah waa arrimo kala duwan.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.b: Sababtoo ah shilal badan ayaa la tiriyay
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.b: Waa halbeegga tirinta ayaa isbeddelay; ma aha in shilal badan la tiriyay.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.c: Sababtoo ah waxaad si cadaalad ah u barbar dhigi kartaa xitaa haddii tirada fuulayaashu beddelanto
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.explain: Haddii aad barbar dhigto tirooyin oo keliya, ma ogaan kartid haddii shilalku hoos u dhaceen sababtoo ah waddada marka dad yar ay fuuleen. Haddii aad ugu beddesho shilal 1,000 qof kasta, waxaad yarayn kartaa saamaynta tirada dadka oo barbar dhigi kartaa.

x-e-h1-08.title: Labada isha runtii ma isku khilaafsan yihiin?
x-e-h1-08.goal: Hel sadarka khaldan ee soo koobidda labada isha oo saxo, oo dooro tallaabada xigta si loo xalliyo is-burinta.
x-e-h1-08.material:
Kuwani waa labo isha iyo soo koobid arday (lambarrada sadarrada soo koobiddu waxay ka bilaabmaan 1).

Isha A (wararka magaalada, March 3): "The Hanbit Library reopened on March 1 after repairs. It now opens seven days a week, and about 300 people visited on the first day."
Isha B (blog-ka maktabadda, March 5): "We reopened on March 2. We are open six days a week, closed on Mondays. More than 300 visitors came on our first day!"
x-e-h1-08.thinking.0: Kala saarista is-burin dhab ah iyo mid muuqda
x-e-h1-08.thinking.1: Helidda iyo saxidda khaladaadka soo koobid
x-e-h1-08.prereq.0: Akhrinta wararka Ingiriis ah iyo qoraallo blog oo gaaban heerka sannadka koowaad ee dugsiga sare
x-e-h1-08.prereq.1: Dareen lambar maalinle ah oo ku filan in lagu go'aamiyo haddii 'about 300' iyo 'more than 300' ay is-waafaqayaan
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar oo khaldan soo koobidda ardayga. (Xitaa haddii laba ama in ka badan oo sadarro ah ay khaldan yihiin, waxaad u baahan tahay inaad doorato mid ka mid ah oo keliya.)
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta, qor lambarrada ama taariikhaha labada isha dhinac-dhinac.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Mid-mid u tijaabi haddii labada lambar ay isla markaa run noqon karaan.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 3 iyo 5 ayaa dhibaato leh. 'about 300' iyo 'more than 300' labadaba way run noqon karaan, sidaas darteed tirada booqdayaashu ma aha is-burin (sadarka 3). Sadarka 5 wuxuu sheegayaa hal isha inay khaldan tahay, laakiin ma ogaan kartid qoraalkan oo keliya kee ayaa khaldan. Is-burinnada sadarrada 2 iyo 4 waa dhab.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: U qaado in sadarka soo koobidda ee barbar dhigaya tirada booqdayaasha labada isha uu khaldan yahay, oo saxo sadarkaas, adigoo ku qorayo hal ama laba weedh Ingiriis ah. Ku dar sida tirada booqdayaasha labada isha ay ula xidhiidhaan.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Si sax ah u koobi sida mid kasta oo ka mid ah labada isha u muujiyo tirada booqdayaasha.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qor baaxadda tirooyinka "about" iyo "more than" mid kasta qeexaan.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma soo baxdaa in 'about 300' iyo 'more than 300' ay wada run noqon karaan?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay magacyada labada isha (Isha A/B) ama erayadooda si sax ah?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu isticmaalay 'agree' si uu u yidhaahdo way is-waafaqayaan.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Wuxuu muujiyay tiro gaar ah (310) in labada ay wada run noqon karaan.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.prompt: Waa maxay tallaabada xigta ee ugu fiican si loo kala saaro haddii maalinta furitaanku ahayd March 1 mise 2?
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir macluumaadkee ayay labada qoraal ku salaysnaayeen.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir isha saddexaad oo aad hubin karto ka hor intaadan rumaysan dhinac midna.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.a: Isha B waxaa lagu qoray taariikh dambe, sidaas darteed raac B adigoon si gooni ah u hubin.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.a: In qoraal dambe la qoray keligeed macnaheedu ma aha taariikhdu inay sax tahay. Waxaad u baahan tahay caddayn si toos ah u hubisay taariikhda.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.b: Hel oo hubi diiwaan taariikhda lagu sameeyay maalinta furitaanka (sida ogeysiis).
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.c: Tirada dadka akhriyay ma damaanad qaado sax ahaanta.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.explain: Si aad u ogaato sababta taariikhuhu u kala duwan yihiin, waxaad u baahan tahay caddayn toos ah, sida diiwaan maalintaas la sameeyay. Waqtiga qorista ama tirada akhristayaasha keligood ma kuu sheegi karaan dhinacee ayaa sax ah.

x-e-h1-10.title: Samaynta wada-hadal diidaysa casuumaad iyadoo la ilaalinayo xidhiidhka
x-e-h1-10.topic: Qorista jawaab ama wada-hadal buuxinaya shuruudaha
x-e-h1-10.goal: Adigu qor wada-hadal Ingiriis ah oo gaaban oo buuxinaya shuruudaha oo dhan (diidmo cad, sabab, beddel, iyo fahamka qofka kale).
x-e-h1-10.material: Saaxiib A wuxuu casuumayaa B inay wada tagaan riwaayad 7 p.m. Sabtida. B wuxuu leeyahay dhacdo qoys fiidkaas wuuna tegi karin.
x-e-h1-10.prereq.0: Akhrinta iyo qorista wada-hadal Ingiriis ah oo gaaban heerka sannadka koowaad ee dugsiga sare
x-e-h1-10.prereq.1: Erayada aasaasiga ah ee la isticmaalo marka aadan aqbali karin casuumaad
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay hab ugu habboon oo B ugu diido?
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi haddii A, ka dib maqalka jawaab kasta, ogaan karo 'B ma tegi karaa mise ma tegi karo'.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbar dhig saameynta dareenka A.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.a: Waa cad tahay, laakiin codku wuxuu yareeyaa casuumaadda qofka kale.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.c: "I'll try" wuu madow yahay haddii ay tahay diidmo ama aqbalaad, sidaas darteed qofka kale ayaa ku adag inuu qorsho sameeyo.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: Marka diidmo cad (can't), sabab, iyo beddel (maalin kale) ay wada jiraan, qofka kale ma fahmo si khaldan oo wuu yar yahay dhaawaca. Jawaab madow ayaa qofka kale sugaysa, hadal aad u qallafsan-na wuxuu cidhiidhi gelinayaa xiriirka.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.prompt:
Samee wada hadal Ingiriisi ah oo u dhexeeya A iyo B. Bilow sadar kasta A: ama B:, oo qor ugu yaraan 4 sadar.
Shuruudda 1) B wuxuu si cad u yidhi ma tegi karo (can't, iwm.).
Shuruudda 2) B wuxuu bixiyaa sabab.
Shuruudda 3) B wuxuu soo jeediyaa maalin kale ama hab kale.
Shuruudda 4) A wuxuu muujiyaa falcelin fahmid ah.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami sababta (munaasabad qoys, iwm.) iyo beddelka (maalin kale), ka dibna qorshee kala horreynta sadarrada.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Qor kala horreynta jawaabta koowaad ee B: ku dar 'thanks', ka dibna isticmaal can't.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Diidmada B ma 'cad' tahay, mise madow tahay sida 'try to come'?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Beddelku ma yahay soo jeedin runtii lagu fulin karo (taariikh ama hab ma jiraa)?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Falcelinta A ma si dabiici ah ayay u raacaysaa?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu buuxiyay isla shuruudaha xataa marka xaaladda la beddelay.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.2: Wuxuu buuxiyay isla shuruudaha erayo kala duwan.
